label: A snapping turtle the size of South America waiting to strike
description: A giant snapping turtle seen over South America, as big as the continent, holding its mouth open and waiting to bite anyone who comes near, facing northwest toward North America and the Panama Canal. People are said to draw back, intimidated by its size. Given 16 May 2025 in tongues and interpretation.
aliases: the whole continent of South America

label: The Middle East rises out of the ashes as the superpower of the earth
description: Saudi Arabia, the OPEC nations and the wider Middle East going digital and rising out of the ashes into a financial global structure never seen before, becoming the superpowers of the world, which he reads as the kingdom being established back where the garden of Eden was.
aliases: they'll become the superpowers of the earth
a financial global structure that you've never seen before

label: The great bells ringing in France
description: Notre Dame named and the great bells heard ringing in France, given in tongues and interpretation alongside a shaking that brings Europe to its knees and the death of Pope Francis read as a sign. Given 13 May 2025.
aliases: I see the bells ringing in France
the great bells ringing in France

label: Venezuela is angered by something and Putin comes to comfort them
description: Venezuela seen becoming angry over something the American president does concerning oil, which he says he cannot identify, and Putin's face seen coming to comfort the Venezuelan government. Given 7 May 2025.
